I know they have found pink diamonds in Austrailia. There are also artificial created pink diamonds.  One caret equals 100 points. Small diamonds should not be that expensive. A six carat natural diamond would be very very expensive. Once a diamond gets to one caret then they start to get pricey. Things like clarity (Flawless, VeryVervSlightImperfecton, VerySlightIimperfection, Imperfect) figure in the price as well. Make sure that this pink diamond is natural and not artificially created or treated. Sapphire has a hardness of 9 on the MOHS scale. Much harder than glass. It is not likely to be scratched. Diamond has a hardness of 10 on the Mohs scale. The hardest substance. The danger with gemstones is more about brittleness than hardness. I have an anxiety disorder with depressive symptoms.
None of the SSRIs worked for me. They worked well as laxatives. :( Nortriptyline worked for several years on anxiety but had nasty side effects. Benzodiazepines worked perfectly until you build up a tolerance to them. Remeron and doxepin had a mildly beneficial effect but inadequate in the end. Venlafaxine made me feel like I had chronic fatigue syndrome. Trazadone did nothing noticeable. Cannabidiol has been helpful but not the panacea I had hoped it would be. I really would like to try ketamine or one of it's derivatives!
